name: Benfotiamine
summary: Benfotiamine is a fat-soluble B1 derivative with diabetic-neuropathy RCTs. A B-vitamin form with nerve-pain trial data distinct from plain thiamine.
description: Canonical Benfotiamine research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
